render_method: Non-generative pdftoppm; Swete158–159 scale-to1800 plus158 at260dpi, Holter selected pages scale-to1600, Balogh selected pages scale-to1700. Originals unchanged; listed renders visually inspected by root.
transcription_reading_method: Select actual primary table and line-verse tr by explicit IDs, first two td cells only; inspect original word-span markup and complete neighboring bracket context; exclude parallel-line displays and preserve physical labels separately from biblical reference anchors.

city_attestation.lexical_contrast: Destruction / Sun; no geographic Heliopolis identification selected

connected_preservation.1QIsaA_19_25: Complete three-part blessing in column16 line3, unbracketed and undotted.
connected_preservation.4Q56_19_25: Egypt/my-people survives with doubtful yod in my-people; most work-of-hands/Assyria supplied; inheritance/Israel wholly supplied.
connected_preservation.1Q8_19_25: Egypt/my-people and almost all work-of-hands supplied; final hands yod doubtful; Assyria/inheritance/Israel outside supply.
connected_preservation.1QIsaA_19_23: At15:32→16:1 no explicit second Egypt noun after the service verb; do not normalize it into the surviving text.
connected_preservation.1Q8_19_23: Second Egypt noun after service verb survives at8a:5; the following Assyria-object phrase is mostly supplied.

greek_selected_edition_findings.19_18: Swete body πόλις ἀσεδέκ; other city forms in apparatus. No direct Hebrew הצדק recovered; no hand attribution selected here.
greek_selected_edition_findings.19_21_22: Egyptians know the Lord, offer, return and are healed; blanket Egyptian-exclusion inference rejected.
greek_selected_edition_findings.19_23: Egyptians explicitly serve Assyrians; Hebrew service-with/service-object analysis is debated and need not imply changed consonants.
greek_selected_edition_findings.19_25: My people in Egypt and among Assyrians; body has γῆ before inheritance, omission separately reported. Not an undifferentiated all-Greek reading.

argument_assessment.balogh: Read original local arguments retaining Destruction, distributive each-one proposal, city-name corruption countermodel and temple-story criticism; proposals not promoted to attested changes.
argument_assessment.holter: Read complete original article; diaspora/resistance interpretation distinguished from demonstrated Vorlage or scribal change; hypothetical Hebrew bet additions not attested.
argument_assessment.review_correction: Explicitly acknowledge Balogh's challenge to comitative service; scholarly disagreement does not certify equal grammatical plausibility.
argument_assessment.source_judgment: Provisional retention of current POB Hebrew and marker-free English, not proof of priority or optimality.

independent_review.status: supports bounded facts and exact proposed City-of-the-Sun note; grammar qualification incorporated
